Setha izinga le-frame elihlosiwe ngaphansi kwemodi yokwehlisa ukulungiswa kwalomdlalo

Thuthukisa inqubo yokuhlela amafrikhwensi kuzo zonke izixhabe ze-CPU (Schedutil/Schedhorizon)
Lungisa ukugcwala kombala wesikrini namandla wesiteshi se-RGB

Lungisa umbala nokugcwala kwesikrini usebenzisa isevisi ye-SurfaceFlinger, ngaphandle kwesidingo sokusekelwa yi-kernel
Izilungiselelo ezikhethekile zesicelo zizokwemboza izilungiselelo ezijwayelekile; ukugcina okuzenzakalelayo kuzothola ukuhlelwa okujwayelekile
Faka ukuhlelwa okungeziwe okuhambisana nedivayisi; uma umdlalo wehlisa ukusebenza, zama ukuvala into ehambisanayo
Kutholwe okuqukethwe kwe-backup, sicela ukhethe izinto ozifuna ukuzibuyisela:
Uma uvula izinga lokuvuselela lalesi sicelo, izinga lokuvuselela lesikrini lizolawulwa ngokuphelele yi-Max Manager
Kuhlonzwa isimo samanje sokushaja kwedivayisi… Sicela ulinde

I-FAS (Frame-Aware Scheduling) ingumsebenzisi osuka endaweni yomsebenzisi, inamandla amaningi nokuvumelana nokuhlelwa uma iqhathaniswa ne-MI FEAS esebenza ku-kernel; iqapha ukuhlelwa kwemisebenzi ngokuqapha ukuhumusha kwezithombe, ithuthukisa ukusebenza ngenkathi inciphisa izindleko zesistimu

I-FPSGO (Frame Per Second Go) iyimojula ye-kernel ye-MediaTek, elungisa i-frequency ye-CPU/GPU ngokuya nge-frame rate yangempela; uma i-frame rate izinzile, yehlisa i-frequency ukonga amandla; uma i-frame rate incane, ikhulisa i-frequency ukugcina ukushelela
Le nketho isekela kuphela amadivayisi e-MediaTek
Sicela unikeze i-Max Manager amandla e-Root
Azikho izici zesistimu ezimaphu amanodi e-bypass atholakalayo
Ngesikhathi ukushaja, misa ukushaja ibhethri, amandla aye ngqo kumotherboard, ukunciphisa kakhulu ukushisa komzimba ngesikhathi sokudlala, futhi kwande impilo yebhethri
Akutholakali ukuxhumeka kwecharger, sicela ufake i-charger bese uqala ukuxilonga
Amandla e-Root anqatshiwe, i-Max Manager izidinga amandla e-Root ukuze isebenze
Sebenzisa ukuxilonga ngenhla, noma hlola ukuthi i-kernel iqukethe yini inodi ye-bypass power supply
Lezi zilungiselelo zisebenza kuzo zonke izicelo ezivuliwe, ungazihlela ngasinye ohlwini lwezicelo
Uma uvuliwe, uma i-frame rate izinzile, i-frequency yehle ngokuzenzakalelayo ukonga amandla; labo abafuna ukusebenza okuphezulu futhi bamukele ukushisa okukhulu bangakwazi ukuvala
Ividiyo inde kakhulu, ubude obukhulu obuvumelekile ngemizuzwana engu-30
Isexwayiso: Le backup ifanele idivayisi ye-%1$s chip, ukuze ugweme ukuqala kabusha okungapheli, ezinye izinto ezihleliwe zizokhawulelwa ekubuyiseleni
Siza ekuthuthukiseni, vumela i-Max Manager ukuthi iqhubeke nokuthuthukiswa
Lawula ngokuhlakanipha inqubo yokulawula izinga lokushisa, gwema ukushisa okweqile kwesistimu ngesikhathi sokusebenza nsuku zonke, futhi uqinisekise ukusebenza okuzinzile kwesistimu
Buyisela amabhulokhi e-flash angasetshenzisiwe engxenyeni yesistimu, thuthukisa ukusebenza kokufunda nokubhala kwe-I/O
Ukukhipha imojula kuzosusa wonke amafayela e-Max Manager, kudingeka uqale kabusha idivayisi, ngabe uyaqhubeka?
Thuthukisa amapharamitha e-WALT governor, thuthukisa ijubane lokuphendula kokuhlela kwe-CPU
Nika amandla ukugqwayiza kokuswayipha phakathi kwamakhasi
Misa i-Max Manager ekusebenziseni ukulungisa kuwo wonke amaphrofayili kuhlanganise nezilungiselelo zomlawuli nesihleli se-I/O
Lungiselela inani lomlawuli we-CPU, GPU nesihleli se-I/O sedivayisi yakho, inani ngalinye lisetshenziswa kuphrofayili ngayinye ye-Max Manager
Indlela yokushaja yokweqa ayikamiswa okwamanje. Sicela uqedele ukumisa usebenzisa Ukuhlola Ukuhambisana kuqala.
Le nketho idinga ukuqalisa kabusha ukuze isebenze. Qhubeka?
Yenza isevisi yangemuva yemojuli ibhale ukusebenza kwayo kwangaphakathi kokuthi MaxManager.log — isebenziseke lapho uxilonga indlela yokuziphatha yemojuli
Awukho umphumela orekhodiwe walolu hlelo lokusebenza okwamanje. Vula uhlelo lokusebenza kanye ukuze injini isebenzise iphrofayela, bese uvuselela.

Lawa ma-chips ayimvilophu yangempela yamandla, hhayi ilebula. Wonke amaphesenti athathwa ekhonweni elikhangiswa yidivayisi (isinyathelo esiphezulu kakhulu esishiwo umshayeli wayo), akulokothi kusuka kusilingi isistimu ivumeleke khona manje. Ngakho-ke amageyimu nokusebenza akuhlali ngaphansi kwedivayisi engathintwa: uma inqubomgomo yedivayisi ibambe isilingi esiphansi icela okukhangiswayo, bese ilogu ibhala ukuthi bekuyini, ukuthi idivayisi ingenzani nokuthi yini ebiceliwe. Ngaphansi kwalokho, isabelo sivala usilingi GPU kanye nayo yonke inqubomgomo CPU ongayimisanga ngesandla, ifinyezwa esinyathelweni sangempela sokuvama, futhi ukusetha kwangaphambili okupholisa (okulinganiselayo, amandla, ngokwezifiso) kwehlisa usilingi kuphela — akulokothi kuphakamise noyedwa. Ngaphezu kwalokho, unogada oshisayo wehlisa usilingi ofanayo ngenkathi idivayisi inyakaza futhi iwabuyisela lapho iphola, ingabi ngaphezu kwalokho okukhethile.
Bonisa izilawuli zabasebenzisi bamandla (ababusi abazenzela, amaphrofayili ashisayo) esikhundleni sokuwagcina evalekile

Ababusi abazenzelayo kanye namaphrofayela ashisayo ayayidlula imikhawulo yokuphepha yedivayisi. Inhlanganisela embi ingabangela ukushisa ngokweqile, ukudonsa kanzima, noma iluphu yokuqalisa kabusha — shintsha eyodwa ngesikhathi futhi ubuke uhlelo lokusebenza imizuzu embalwa.
Bonisa kuphela izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinezilungiselelo ngokwezifiso
Shuna ukusebenza, isibonisi, amageyimu, nokuziphatha kwamandla ngohlelo lokusebenza ngalunye.

Ngena zonke izilungiselelo ozishintshayo nalo lonke uhlelo lokusebenza lushintshele ku-MaxManager.log, olumakwe nge-id eyabiwe ukuze inkinga ilandelelwe ukuthi iyini imbangela. Vala ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Izingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha GPU ukusetha ngaphambilini kwefrikhwensi nokushuna mathupha
GPU isilawuli semvamisa asitholakali kule divayisi.

Izinguquko zemvamisa zisetshenziswa ngemingcele ye-devfreq ye-kernel futhi uhlale ngaphakathi kokuvikela okushisayo kwehadiwe yakho. Max Manager ayikuvimbeli ukuvikela ukushisa ngokweqile.
I-Kernel GPU Iphayiphi le-Extension Driver boost ukuze kukhuphuke ngokushesha lapho uthinta kanye nokwethulwa kohlelo lokusebenza.
Ayikho i-boost node ye-GED etholakele kule divayisi.
Ilawula GPU isizinda samandla we-shader core kanye nezimo zokulala zokungenzi lutho.

Ibeka u-GPU eduze nendawo ephansi yobubanzi bayo ukuze wonge amandla.
Ibanga lefrikhwensi yehadiwe egcwele, ukuziphatha kombusi okuzenzakalelayo.
Igcina GPU kububanzi obungaphezulu ukuze kuhambisane nokuhamba kozimele okushelelayo emidlalweni.
Ikhiya i-GPU ngobuningi bayo obuphezulu behadiwe etholakalayo.
Iphoqelela idivayisi yokupholisa eshisayo ye-GPU\'s esimweni sayo sokunganyakazi futhi iyikhiya ukufunda kuphela, ikhipha ikhono le-OS lokucindezela kabusha GPU ngokushisa.

Lokhu kususa isivikelo esishisayo esivamise ukubambezela u-GPU uma kushisa kakhulu. Ngaphansi komthwalo osindayo oqhubekayo (amaseshini emidlalo amade, amabhentshimakhi) idivayisi yakho ingase isebenze ngokushisa kakhulu kunokujwayelekile, okungabangela ukuvalwa kokushisa, ukuguga kwebhethri ngokushesha, izinga lokushisa lesikhumba elingakhululekile, futhi ezimeni ezimbi kakhulu kulimale ihadiwe unomphela. Vumela lokhu kuphela uma uqonda futhi wamukela leyo ngozi. Ungayivala futhi noma nini kulesi sikrini.

Ukuphina mathupha noma ukuvala imvamisa GPU\'s kweqa umthwalo womshayeli nokuphathwa kokushisa. Iphushele kude futhi ungase ubone ama-graphic glitches, throttling, noma ukuqalisa kabusha - shintsha isilungiselelo esisodwa ngesikhathi.
Shintsha ukulungiswa kokunikezwa kanye nokuminyana kwephikseli iphaneli edweba kuyo
Setha kabusha isibonisi sibe ukulungiswa komdabu?
Lokhu kusula noma yikuphi ukulungiswa noma ukubhala ngaphezulu kokuminyana futhi kubuyisela isikrini kuzilungiselelo zangempela zomkhiqizi.
Ukunciphisa ukulungiswa kunciphisa GPU umthwalo wokunikezela futhi kungathuthukisa impilo yebhethri noma ukuqina kozimele; ayishintshi iphaneli ebonakalayo. Ungasetha kabusha komdabu noma kunini.
Ukushintshanisa ngosayizi okucindezelwe kanye nokulungisa kabusha kwenkumbulo ye-kernel
Inikeza %1$d MB ukuhlukaniswa okucindezelwe kokushintshashintsha okubonakalayo (kufika ku-%2$.1f GB).
Amanani aphezulu avumela ukushintshwa kokuthi ZRAM maduze; amanani aphansi avumela ukugcina idatha iku-RAM
Umzimba omsulwa RAM kuphela, akukho ukushintshaniswa okucindezelwe.

Lokhu kuvala ukushintshwa okucindezelwe ngokuphelele. Ukwenza izinto eziningi ezisindayo kungabangela izinhlelo zokusebenza ukuthi zivalwe futhi zilayishwe kabusha kaningi njengoba kungekho ukushintshana okungavula futhi.

Ukushintsha ZRAM usayizi noma i-algorithm yokuminyanisa ithinta indlela isistimu ephatha ngayo ingcindezi yesistimu yonke. Inhlanganisela engasekelwe ingabangela ukungazinzi noma ukushintsha kohlelo lokusebenza kancane — sebenzisa inguquko eyodwa ngesikhathi futhi unikeze amaminithi ambalwa.

ZRAM shintsha usayizi kafushane kungasebenzi ukushintsha ngenkathi isetha kabusha idivayisi, okuyinto evamile futhi ethatha isikhashana nje. Osayizi abakhulu kakhulu bahweba ngesinye isikhathi CPU (ngokuminyanisa) ukuthola inkumbulo esebenziseka kakhudlwana.
Khetha injini yokucindezela i-kernel yesikhathi sangempela yedivayisi ye-block ZRAM.
Ihweba ngokuminyanisa okuthile ngezindleko eziphansi CPU, ngakho ukuskrola nemidlalo kuhlala kushelela.
Icindezela idatha eningi ibe okungenani RAM, ngezindleko CPU ngaphezulu komsebenzi ngekhasi ngalinye.
I-algorithm ye-kernel evamile ye-Android enobude bokusheshisa kwekhasi elinguziro.
I-algorithm yokucindezelwa yesisekelo esidala, egcinelwe ukuhambisana.

Ikhuphula izinga lombiko wesilawuli sokuthinta kanye nokuzwela kwemodi yegeyimu ngokufaka okusheshayo, okunembe kakhudlwana phakathi nokudlala.
Ayikho inodi yesilawuli sokuthinta esekelwe etholakele kule divayisi, ngakho i-touch boost ayikwazi ukunikwa amandla lapha.
I-HAL yomthengisi we-Xiaomi iyatholakala. Max Manager isebenzisa i-ITouchFeature interface ye-ROM esikhundleni sokuqagela inodi ye-sysfs.

Nweba ububanzi obuguquguqukayo nokujula kokuqukethwe kwe-HDR
Iwindi, uguquko, kanye nesilinganiso sobude besikhathi sopopayi \u2014 sizizwa siphansi
Isikrini sihlala isikhathi esingakanani sivuliwe uma singenzi lutho
Tinta isibonisi esifudumele ukuze unciphise ukucindezelwa kwamehlo ebusuku
Ukufunda i-CPU topology kanye nezinqubomgomo ze-cpufreq ezivezwa yile kernel.

Khetha ngesandla ukuthi yimaphi ama-cores ahlala esebenza, iqoqo ngalinye
I-Per-core hotplug control ayitholakali kule divayisi.
Nika amandla ukuvula/ukuvala ama-core processor angawodwana. Iseshini kuphela \u2014 isetha kabusha ekuqaliseni kabusha.

Ukucisha ama-cores kunciphisa ukudonsa kwamandla kodwa kwehlisa ukusebenza okunemicu eminingi. I-master core (CPU0) ayikwazi ukuvalwa ukusuka lapha \u2014 izinhlamvu eziningi ziyenqaba noma kunjalo njengoba iziphazamiso ziphiniwe.
Khetha ukuthi yimaphi ama-cores iqembu ngalinye elihlelayo elivunyelwe ukusebenzisa uchungechunge \u2014 isb. phina \"Uhlelo Lokusebenza Oluphezulu\" kuqoqo lokusebenza kuphela.
Khetha ama-cores leli qembu elingahlela uchungechunge kuwo. Iseshini kuphela \u2014 isetha kabusha ekuqaliseni kabusha.
Setha phansi kanye nosilingi iqoqo ngalinye, noma phina iqoqo libe isinyathelo esisodwa. Konke okubhaliwe kuqinisekiswa ngokumelene nehadiwe.
Buyisela yonke iqoqo emikhawulweni ebinayo ngenkathi kuvulwa lesi sikrini
Iphansi kanye nophahla kukhiyiwe ukuze imvamisa efanayo
Leli qoqo alishicileli ithebula lemvamisa elingakhethwa, ngakho imikhawulo ebukhoma ihlala ifundwa kuphela.

Iphrofayela yomhlaba wonke MaxManager noma isevisi yokushisa yedivayisi isebenzisa imikhawulo ehlukene.
I-node ingase ivikelwe, noma ingase ingalamukeli leli nani.
Inani eliceliwe lingaphandle kobubanzi obufakazelwa yile nqubomgomo. Ukubhala kuboshelwe emkhawulweni ofakazelwe, ngakho-ke inodi ayizange ibuzwe inani eliceliwe.
Ukungqubuzana okuqhubekayo: enye inkampane iqhubeka nokusebenzisa imikhawulo ehlukene, ngakho ukugomela kabusha okuzenzakalelayo kuyekile ukuze kuvikelwe ukuzinza.
Imikhawulo yakho isamile kule seshini: iphrofayili yomhlaba wonke ngeke ize iphinde isethwe uze uyibuyisele.
Amanani abuyiselwe emuva afana nalokho okuceliwe.
Ububanzi obugcwele bezingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha bubuyiselwe futhi baqinisekiswa.
Imikhawulo yokuqala yeseshini ibuyiselwe futhi yaqinisekiswa.
Ukuphepha okushisayo kuphethe le knob njengamanje. Isicelo sakho sigciniwe futhi sizosetshenziswa uma sidedelwa \u2014 akukho okushintshile kudivayisi okwamanje.
Umnikazi obaluleke kakhulu (%1$s) uphethe le knobhu. Isicelo sakho sigciniwe futhi sizosetshenziswa ekukhishweni \u2014 akukho okushintshile kudivayisi okwamanje.
Umbhalo uphumile kodwa awuphindanga wafunda njengoba kwakuceliwe, ngakho amanani ashiywe enjengoba ayenjalo.
I-cpufreq node engemuva kwale nqubomgomo akuyona neyodwa MaxManager engasho igama, ngakho-ke akukho okubhaliwe.
Umshayeli akayivezi imingcele yezingxenyekazi zekhompuyutha zale nqubomgomo, ngakho-ke akukho okungabuyiselwa kukho.
Ayikho imikhawulo esetshenziswe ngesandla eyarekhodwa kule seshini, ngakho-ke bekungekho lutho olungabuyiselwa.
Eminye imikhawulo ayikwazanga ukubuyiselwa. Funda amanani abukhoma ngezansi.
I-core topology ayikwazanga ukufundwa, ngakho akukho ukusetha ngaphambilini okungasetshenziswa.
Izimo eziyinhloko azikwazanga ukufundwa futhi, ngakho umphumela wokusetha ngaphambilini awaziwa kunokuba ube yimpumelelo.
Ukusetha ngaphambilini akushintshile lutho olungabonwa ngumfundi. I-kernel ingase igcine lawa ma cores esesimweni esingashintshi.
Ukusetha ngaphambilini kusetshenzisiwe: %1$d kwezingu-%2$d cores manje zifundelwa emuva njengokuku-inthanethi.

Lokhu kususa %1$s kumsebenzisi wamanje kuphela. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zesistimu ngokuvamile zingabuyiswa ngokuthi \"pm install-existing\" noma ngokusetha kabusha kwasembonini \u2014 lokhu akukhona ukususa unomphela APK kusuka /kusistimu.

Isihlungi se-ART sisetshenziselwa ukuhlanganisa izenzo ngezansi
Lokhu kuphoqa-kuhlanganisa lonke uhlelo lokusebenza olufakiwe ngesihlungi esikhethiwe. Kungathatha isikhathi eside futhi kushisise idivayisi \u2014 uyigcine ixhunyiwe futhi ungayiphazamisi.
Lokhu kuphoqa-kuhlanganisa lonke uhlelo lokusebenza lwesistimu ngesihlungi esikhethiwe. Kungathatha isikhashana kuye ngokuthi zingaki izinhlelo zokusebenza zesistimu ezifakiwe.
Lokhu kuphoqa-kuhlanganisa lonke uhlelo lokusebenza olufakwe umsebenzisi ngesihlungi esikhethiwe.

Lokhu kusula ama-artifact aqoqiwe kulo lonke uhlelo lokusebenza olufakiwe, kuwabuyisela esimweni sawo sokuhlanganiswa kwesikhathi sesifaki. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zizophinda zihlanganiswe ngemuva noma ekuqalisweni okulandelayo, okungase kubangele ukwehla kwesikhashana.
